# VectorPop

> VectorPop converts PNG and JPEG raster images into clean, scalable SVG vector files. Available on Windows, Android, and web. Also home to VectoFix, a companion tool for spot-fixing vectorization errors by hand.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.vectorpop.fr/): Product overview, features, pricing, download.
- [VectoFix](https://www.vectorpop.fr/vectofix): Manual correction brush for fixing vectorization artifacts.
- [Blog](https://www.vectorpop.fr/blog): Guides on PNG-to-SVG conversion, SVG vs PNG use cases.

## Key facts
- Platforms: Windows (desktop), Android (Google Play), web.
- Converts raster logos and images to editable SVG vectors.
- Free tier available; Pro license unlocks batch conversion and higher-resolution output.
- Built and maintained by La Fabrik Numérique.

## Contact
- Website: https://www.vectorpop.fr
